title: Introduce profile deduplication and changelog consolidator
author: Lina Park
description: Motivation: the registry accumulates near-duplicate performance profiles and micro-changelog entries when models are iteratively profiled (small sequence-length sweeps, quantization experiments, or backfilled calibration runs). This inflates storage, complicates release-note history, and makes candidate rollouts noisy. This PR introduces two cooperating pieces: 1) a profile deduplication/canonicalization pipeline that groups profiles by a fingerprint and merges small deltas using configurable heuristics; and 2) a changelog consolidator that compresses sequences of small profile updates into a single human-friendly release note with impact summaries. What changed: added a fingerprint generator (sha1 over canonicalized metadata+profile-stats), a merge policy engine (thresholds for metric drift, quantization tags, and sample-size weighting), conflict-resolution hooks that preserve provenance and earliest-commit attribution, and a rollback CLI (registry rollback apply --since <commit>) that replays canonical state to a chosen checkpoint. The changelog consolidator implements grouping rules (time-window, semantic-impact buckets) and templated summarizers that produce both short and extended notes; it also exposes a --dry-run mode for maintainers. Implementation notes: new service module src/dedupe/, CLI extension at cli/registry.py, a GitHub Action workflow .github/workflows/changelog-consolidator.yml for nightly runs, and unit+integration tests under tests/dedupe/ and tests/integration/changelog/. Tests simulate a stream of 120 profile commits across 3 model families and assert that dedupe reduces stored profiles by ~18% while retaining highest-quality representative profiles. Backwards compatibility: original profiles are retained in a compressed provenance archive and remain addressable by hash. Rollout: feature gated behind config.flags.profile_dedupe and changelog.enabled; disabled by default for first two weeks while we monitor regressions. Ops runbook: added notes to docs/ops/registry-dedupe.md for how to tune merge thresholds and how to force-preserve profiles. Why it matters: reduces registry clutter, yields concise release notes for model teams, and makes automated rollouts cleaner by reducing spurious deltas. Linked linear tickets: ENG-4219 (dedupe engine), ENG-4301 (changelog UX).

review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Can you add a brief benchmark for CPU overhead during nightly runs? The dedupe loop looks O(n^2) in naive path; consider locality sharding.
Lina Park: Added a micro-benchmark and a sharding optimization in merge_policy.py; nightly runs now shard by model-family and use a bloom filter to avoid repeated pairwise compares.
Aisha Thompson: The changelog templates look good; please include example output in docs and add a link to the related Linear ticket in the generated note metadata.
Lina Park: Included examples and attach linear keys in the consolidated note metadata. Also added --preserve-hash flag to force-pin specific profiles.
Ben Carlson: Approved after CI green and small nits fixed (doc link, log level).
release_notes: Added profile deduplication and changelog consolidation; reduces registry storage of redundant profiles by ~18% in our test corpus; provides a rollback CLI and provenance-backed archives. Feature is behind a flag and off by default. Ops docs added for tuning merge thresholds.
notes_on_migration: No forced migration; runs compactly when enabled and writes provenance archive for any merged profiles. Administrators can run cli/registry.py export-provenance --since <date> before enabling if they prefer snapshots.
examples: Example consolidated changelog short: 'Consolidated 12 micro-profiles for model: llama-2-13b; representative profile chosen: quantized-int8; median latency change: +0.8ms; token-cost delta: -3.2%.'
tests_summary: Unit and integration tests added; simulated workload with 120 commits across 3 families; assertions verify dedupe ratio, retention of top-quality profile per cluster, and changelog human summaries. CI observed 18% storage reduction in test environment.
post_merge_actions: Feature flag enabled in staging for 72h; ops to run nightly consolidator via provided GH Action and review consolidated notes in #model-registry channel. Follow-up: schedule canary for production roll (ENG-4380).
